The second paragraph mentions non-alignment practiced by Ghana and other countries, involving cooperation with all states regardless of whether they are capitalist, socialist, or mixed economies.  
This reflects the Cold War context, where newly independent nations often avoided alignment with either the US-led capitalist bloc or the Soviet-led socialist bloc.  
Thus, the cooperation mentioned refers to navigating between the competing ideologies of the Cold War.
